# Lucas de Almeida

> Computer Engineering student at UFRPE (Recife, Brazil) exploring how to build and secure blockchain applications, with a particular interest in Solana, smart contracts and DeFi security. Before software, spent several years in real estate, construction and business operations, leading teams and managing projects. Open to blockchain internships and junior opportunities (Solana, smart-contract engineering, security). The site documents what he is building, learning and improving.

## Now

- Studying Computer Engineering fundamentals at UFRPE.
- Smart-contract security (Cyfrin Updraft) and cybersecurity basics (TryHackMe).
- Tools: Solidity, Foundry, Hardhat, Rust, Anchor.
